fields.Name: T236 - New Conversation Empty State
fields.Description: Renders the ConversationEmptyStateComponent branch (isNewConversation/!conversationId) with suggested prompts and greeting — distinct from the populated message-list view.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose 'Chat', and wait for the workspace to load. Click the 'New Conversation' button in the left sidebar. Confirm the empty-state welcome renders in the main area: a 'Welcome to Conversations' greeting, one or more suggested prompt cards, a message composer input, and footer tips mentioning using '@AgentName' and pressing Enter to send. Seeing the welcome empty state with its composer is success — you do NOT need to send anything. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'New Conversation' shows the welcome empty state ('Welcome to Conversations' or similar greeting)
Suggested prompt cards and/or footer tips (e.g. '@AgentName', 'Enter to send') are visible
A message composer/input box is present and ready for typing
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
